objective: Diagnosticar en modo solo lectura si HRLectura puede acceder a TABLAJERIA y tablajeria_mpro. No modificar permisos, no ejecutar GRANT, no crear usuarios, no tocar Produccion.

queries.name: current_security_context
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS current_database, SYSTEM_USER AS system_user_name, USER_NAME() AS database_user_name, @@SERVERNAME AS server_name

queries.name: legacy_db_access_matrix
queries.sql: SELECT name AS database_name, HAS_DBACCESS(name) AS has_dbaccess FROM sys.databases WHERE name IN ('TABLAJERIA','tablajeria_mpro','EDARSAHUB') ORDER BY name

queries.name: legacy_db_ids_visibility
queries.sql: SELECT DB_ID('TABLAJERIA') AS dbid_tablajeria, DB_ID('tablajeria_mpro') AS dbid_tablajeria_mpro, DB_ID('EDARSAHUB') AS dbid_edarsahub

queries.name: current_login_server_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT entity_name, subentity_name, permission_name FROM sys.fn_my_permissions(NULL, 'SERVER') ORDER BY permission_name
